name: 화염 드래곤
creator: colorsocks
design: a broad chunky red fire dragon BOSS, standing on exactly TWO short thick hind legs, facing RIGHT. Large compact horned head, no long neck, squat red belly with ONE orange belly field, two short forearms with mitten-like claws, TWO broad folded wings (near wing fully visible, far wing partly occluded), two cream horns and short cream claws. Wing membranes ONE flat orange shape with at most one dark structural line. Thick tail curves to LEFT with a plain pointed red tip. Horned head and broad wings are the two large identity elements. Wings stay below head top in neutral pose. Friendly fierce simplified game creature, not realistic reptile; no scales, no segmented belly lines, no spiky fringe, no realistic muscles or gloss. Six flat colors.

reference.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Create a NEW single 2D cartoon game sprite. The supplied white wolf is only the flat-color, bold-outline style reference. Draw a chunky RED DRAGON BOSS facing RIGHT, standing on TWO short thick back legs, with TWO short forearms, TWO cream horns, TWO broad folded wings, a short thick tail curving left, one orange belly field, one orange field inside each wing. No long neck. Big head, broad body. The tail ends in a simple pointed red tip: NO FIRE, NO FLAMES. Tiny dark oval eye and cheeky frown. Six opaque flat spot colors only: dark #231B15 contour; red #C94943 body; orange #E99D46 belly and wing membranes; cream #E5D7B1 horns and claws; dark red #8E373E far wing; gold #E6BC55 small accents. NO luminous parts, NO glow, NO aura, NO shadow, NO lights, NO shading, NO gradients, NO smoke. Every exterior pixel beyond the crisp dark contour must be fully transparent. Full body entirely visible with generous transparent margin, no ground, no backdrop, no labels. This is a clean flat printed sticker, not a rendered or illuminated dragon.
